newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Aug M2 falls to +13.2 pct yr/yr (+17.6 July).
newsitem.headline: Czech Aug M2 falls to +13.2 pct yr/yr (+17.6 July).

text.p: Growth in the key measure of Czech money supply, M2, fell to a year-on-year rate of 13.2 percent in August from 17.6 percent in July, including money from a 1995 equity expansion of SPT Telecom a.s., the Czech National Bank said on Friday.
With the SPT money factored out the M2 rise was 15.7 percent in August from 17.1 percent in July, it said.
CZECH M2 MONEY AUG 1996 JULY 1996 AUG 1995

Note. M2 measures currency, demand deposits, time and savings deposits, and foreign currency deposits. The bottom figures exlude the effect of SPT Telecom's $1.32 billion equity expansion in the summer of 1995 which was put on deposit at the Czech National Bank (CNB).
The total volume of crown and foreign currency credits granted to clients in August rose by 13 percent, year-on-year, compared with 13.2 percent in July.
The total volume of crown and foreign currency deposits, including SPT funds in banks, grew in August by 12.3 percent, year-on-year, compared with 17.2 percent growth in July.
The CNB said the average interest rate on new crown credits drawn by clients in August rose to 13.92 percent from 13.82 percent in July, the CNB said.
